source.title: Quarterly Examination 2017-2018, Std. VIII, Mathematics
source.subject: mathematics
source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typeset school paper whose text layer uses a broken font encoding (unreadable), so it was OCR'd and corrected against the rendered pages. Header printed: 'Quarterly Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : VIII', 'Subject : MATHEMATICS', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2hrs.+15min. reading time' (durationMinutes 120 = the 2 hours of writing time; the 15 minutes reading time is extra). examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed academic year 2017-2018. No school name printed (only 'KSMS' appears inside Q.8(c)). Section A: answer all questions (Q.1-Q.4); Section B [40 MARKS]: answer any four questions (Q.5-Q.10), so the listed marks exceed 80. Q.3(c), the unlabelled-'(i)' coin item after Q.4(b) and Q.8(b) have no printed marks (marks 0, flagged). Sub-parts with a printed per-part mark ('2x3=6') are split; other multi-part questions are kept whole. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
